verdict.rationale: The Message Batches API is documented for asynchronously processing large volumes of Messages requests at 50% lower cost and higher throughput, which directly delivers bulk operations across many items. Parallel tool use, where Claude calls multiple tools in one response, adds in-loop multi-item actions. missing for 10: documented batch size limits, per-item status and result-retrieval semantics, cancellation and partial-failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
